title: Toward optimal exponent pairs
judgment_notes: Exponent pair database drawing on many papers (e.g. 2306.05599 Trudgian-Yang).

source.citation: Analytic Number Theory Exponent Database: results from many papers (Huxley, Bourgain, Heath-Brown, Trudgian-Yang 2306.05599, Guth-Maynard, ...); companion paper Tao, Trudgian, Yang, New exponent pairs, zero density estimates, and zero additive energy estimates: a systematic approach (arXiv 2501.16779)
source.scope: database of known bounds; each entry restates a cited theorem from its paper
source.evidence: README: "ANTEDB, an ongoing project to systematically record known theorems for various exponents appearing in analytic number theory"; 100+ cite keys (bourgain_dirichlet_2000, heath-brown, huxley ...). 2501.16779 (44 pp.) is the companion paper derived from the database.
